blocks.name: Se
blocks.description: Effort source; imposes the effort on its bond.

blocks.name: Sf
blocks.description: Flow source; imposes the flow on its bond.

blocks.name: MSe
blocks.description: Modulated effort source; the effort comes from a signal input.

blocks.name: C
blocks.description: Capacitive storage; integral causality by preference.

blocks.name: I
blocks.description: Inertial storage; integral causality by preference.

blocks.name: R
blocks.description: Resistive element; free causality.

blocks.name: TF
blocks.description: Transformer; power conserving, with the modulus n.

blocks.name: GY
blocks.description: Gyrator; power conserving, with the modulus r.

blocks.name: De
blocks.description: Effort detector; reads the effort, imposes zero flow.

blocks.name: Df
blocks.description: Flow detector; reads the flow, imposes zero effort.

blocks.name: Constant
blocks.description: Constant signal source.

blocks.name: Step
blocks.description: Step signal source.

blocks.name: Sine
blocks.description: Sine signal source; frequency in rad/s.

blocks.name: Gain
blocks.description: Multiplies the input by a constant gain.

blocks.name: Sum
blocks.description: Signed sum of a vector of inputs; N is a structural constant (D10).

blocks.name: Integrator
blocks.description: Integrates the input; the start value comes from the variable's start override.

blocks.name: PIController
blocks.description: Parallel-form PI controller with a tunable gain and integral time.

blocks.name: Resistor
blocks.description: Electrical resistor between p and n.

blocks.name: Capacitor
blocks.description: Electrical capacitor; the initial voltage is the start value of v.

blocks.name: Inductor
blocks.description: Electrical inductor; the initial current is the start value of i.

blocks.name: Ground
blocks.description: Electrical reference node; holds its port at zero voltage.

blocks.name: VoltageSource
blocks.description: Signal-controlled voltage source; feed it a Constant for a constant source.

parameters.name: V
parameters.description: Voltage gain on the control input

blocks.name: Mass
blocks.description: Point mass between two translation ports; initial position and velocity come from the start values of x and v.

blocks.name: Spring
blocks.description: Linear translational spring between two ports.

blocks.name: Damper
blocks.description: Linear viscous damper between two translation ports.

blocks.name: Fixed
blocks.description: Fixed point; holds its port at zero velocity.

blocks.name: ForceSource
blocks.description: Signal-controlled force source between two translation ports.

parameters.name: F
parameters.description: Force gain on the control input

blocks.name: Inertia
blocks.description: Rotational inertia between two rotation ports; initial angle and speed come from the start values of phi and w.

blocks.name: TorsionSpring
blocks.description: Linear torsional spring between two rotation ports.

blocks.name: RotationalDamper
blocks.description: Linear viscous damper between two rotation ports.

blocks.name: FixedShaft
blocks.description: Fixed shaft; holds its port at zero angular velocity.

blocks.name: TorqueSource
blocks.description: Signal-controlled torque source between two rotation ports.

parameters.name: T
parameters.description: Torque gain on the control input

blocks.name: IdealGear
blocks.description: Lossless gear with ratio n; a is the fast shaft, a.f = n * b.f.

blocks.name: DCMotor
blocks.description: Permanent-magnet DC motor as a composite (winding, gyrator, rotor): electrical p and n, rotational shaft and housing.
blocks.source:
@block DCMotor begin
    @ports begin
        p::Power{Electrical}
        n::Power{Electrical}
        shaft::Power{Rotation}
        housing::Power{Rotation}
    end
    # J2.6b: a composite's parameters are exposed at the composite's own path (`Motor1/R`)
    # and aliased into the components below, so they stay runtime-tunable (decision D4).
    @parameters begin
        R::Real = 2.0, [unit = "Ohm", min = 0, description = "Winding resistance"]
        L::Real = 5e-4, [unit = "H", min = 0, description = "Winding inductance"]
        k_t::Real = 0.05, [unit = "N*m/A", description = "Torque constant"]
        J::Real = 1e-5, [unit = "kg*m^2", min = 0, description = "Rotor inertia"]
        d::Real = 0.0, [unit = "N*m*s/rad", min = 0, description = "Internal viscous damping"]
    end
    @components begin
        resistor = Resistor(R = R)
        inductor = Inductor(L = L)
        # The electrical side is wired through `gyrator.p` and `gyrator.n` in reverse: with
        # the gyrator's `shaft.e = +k*p.f`, that makes the motor torque at the shaft -k_t*i
        # and the back-EMF +k_t*w_rel, the orientation CONTRACT-5 measured for the flat block.
        gyrator = EMConverter(k = k_t)
        rotor = Inertia(J = J)
        damping = RotationalDamper(d = d)
    end
    @connections begin
        connect(p, resistor.p)
        connect(resistor.n, inductor.p)
        connect(inductor.n, gyrator.n)
        connect(gyrator.p, n)
        # The rotor Inertia and the internal damper sit across shaft-housing; the shaft face
        # is exposed through the rotor, so the external load joins the same rotational node.
        connect(shaft, rotor.a)
        connect(rotor.a, gyrator.shaft)
        connect(rotor.a, damping.a)
        connect(rotor.b, housing)
        connect(rotor.b, damping.b)
    end
    # The flat block's recorded signals keep their names at the composite path.
    @observables begin
        i = inductor.i
        w_rel = rotor.w
        p.e = resistor.p.e
        p.f = resistor.p.f
        n.e = gyrator.p.e
        n.f = gyrator.p.f
        shaft.e = rotor.a.e
        shaft.f = rotor.a.f
        housing.e = rotor.b.e
        housing.f = rotor.b.f
    end
end
